scenes.narration: Try not to yawn while watching this. Good luck.
scenes.art: a cute round cartoon character doing an enormous dramatic yawn with eyes squeezed shut, cozy night sky background

scenes.narration: Yawning is contagious. Seeing a yawn, hearing one, even reading about one can set you off.
scenes.art: a chain reaction of cartoon people on a bus yawning one after another like dominoes, funny

scenes.narration: Feeling it yet? Your jaw is probably getting ready right now.
scenes.art: a young adult trying very hard to suppress a yawn, jaw trembling, eyes watering, comedic close up

scenes.narration: One old idea says you yawn to get more oxygen. But when people breathed extra oxygen in an experiment, they yawned just as much.
scenes.art: a young adult wearing a funny oversized oxygen mask still yawning hugely, a scientist with a clipboard shrugging

scenes.narration: Nobody knows for sure why yawns spread. But one clue points to how close we are to each other.
scenes.art: a cartoon magnifying glass hovering over a group of friends yawning together on a couch at night

scenes.narration: In one study, yawns spread most between family, then friends, then acquaintances, and least between strangers.
scenes.art: four groups of cartoon people in a row from a close family hugging to friends to coworkers to strangers, yawning less and less from left to right

scenes.narration: And it doesn't stop with humans. In one experiment, twenty-one out of twenty-nine dogs yawned after watching a person yawn.
scenes.art: a cute fluffy dog sitting in front of a person, both yawning at the same time, warm living room

scenes.narration: When the person just opened their mouth without yawning, none of the dogs yawned.
scenes.art: the same cute dog staring unimpressed at a person making a silly open mouth face, comedic deadpan dog

scenes.narration: So if your dog yawns back at you, it might be more than just being sleepy.
scenes.art: a sleepy happy dog yawning while snuggled next to its owner on a couch, little hearts floating

scenes.narration: Fun fact: even thinking about yawning can trigger one. And you've been thinking about it this whole time.
scenes.art: a cartoon brain wearing a nightcap yawning, thought bubbles full of tiny yawning faces

scenes.narration: Okay, be honest. How many times did you yawn?

post.title: Try not to yawn (you will) 🥱
post.description:
Why yawns are contagious, who catches them most, and why your dog might yawn back at you.

Sources:
